items.question: What preliminary rite must precede installing the deity upon the trident?
premises: An auspicious benediction must be caused to be recited.
This recitation is performed at the beginning.
The deity is to be placed on the trident.
items.inference: The recitation of the auspicious benediction must be completed before placing the deity on the trident.
items.plain_english: First, having had the auspicious benediction recited, one should place the deity on the trident.
